Load WP model

Source: R/wp_model.R
load_wp_model.Rd

Resolution order, matching load_epv_model() / load_xpass_model():

  1. Explicit path (if supplied and the file exists)

  2. pannamodels package (preferred — distributes wp_model via the epv release tag, downloaded + cached on first call)

  3. Local fallback at pannadata/data/opta/models/wp_model.rds

Usage

load_wp_model(path = NULL)

Arguments

path

Directory to load from. If NULL, tries pannamodels first then falls back to pannadata/data/opta/models/.

Value

WP model list (model + feature_names).

See also

Other win probability: add_wp_vars(), aggregate_player_game_wpa(), assign_wpa_credit(), create_wp_features(), predict_wp(), save_wp_model(), train_wp_model()
